annotations.title: Which catalog Meta would show under a new ad

description: Meta can show products from a catalog under a new ad by default (the product showcase). This previews what it would pick for an ad account before the ad is made: the catalog and product sets, each on by default or waiting for confirmation, or why there is none (no catalog, not enough context, not enabled). Pass adAccountId, objective (OUTCOME_SALES default, OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT or OUTCOME_LEADS) and adUrl and/or pageId; without either Meta cannot suggest. It applies to ads created from now on, and a creative’s product extensions cannot be changed after it is made. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_ optional), from list_meta_ads

adUrl.description: the landing page the ad will open (recommended)

objective.description: the campaign objective of the ad you plan (default OUTCOME_SALES)

pageId.description: the Facebook Page the ad will run from
